# 2 Clement — Chapter 10 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 10
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. So then, brothers, let us do the will of the Father who called us, that we may live; and let us pursue virtue more earnestly, abandoning every evil habit as the forerunner of our good deeds, lest we suffer awful things if we are negligent about the Lord's commandments.
2. For the Lord says: "Even if you are gathered together with me in my bosom and do not keep my commandments, I will cast you away and say to you: Depart from me; I do not know you, from where you are — you workers of lawlessness."
3. Therefore, brothers, let us forsake our sojourning in this world and do the will of him who called us, and let us not be afraid of leaving this world.
4. For the Lord says: "You shall be as lambs in the midst of wolves."
5. But Peter answered and said to him: "What then if the wolves tear the lambs in pieces?"
6. Jesus said to Peter: "Let the lambs not fear the wolves after death. And as for you — fear not those who kill you and are able to do nothing more, but fear him who, after your death, has authority to cast into the Gehenna of fire; and know that this authority is his alone."
